summary: Israel activated Division 98 headquarters in Judea and Samaria for the first time in over two decades, splitting sector command between two divisions to enhance control amid rising tensions. A ramming attack at Maccabim checkpoint seriously wounded a reserve soldier, the son of Israel's ambassador to the US, with the terrorist eliminated on scene. Hezbollah is reportedly transferring precision missiles and military equipment to villages west of the Blue Line south of the Litani River to establish fortified rear positions.
key_points: IDF activates Division 98 HQ in Judea and Samaria, assuming command of Judea and Etzion brigades per Chief of Staff Eyal Zamir. (Source: @inon_yttach/10056)
Ramming attack at Maccabim checkpoint in Benjamin Brigade seriously wounds reserve soldier Neria Leiter; terrorist eliminated by forces on scene. (Source: @almogboker78/18246)
Hezbollah transferring precision missiles, defense systems, and weapons to villages west of Blue Line south of Litani, including Aqlim al-Tuffah and Jabal al-Rihan. (Source: @New_security8200/203900)
IRGC attacks Indian bulk carrier Cape Dao in Strait of Hormuz, killing one crew member and injuring another; ship evacuated and burning. (Source: @VahidOnline/78499)
Israeli combat engineers locate 600-meter tunnel in central Gaza crossing from Israeli side of Yellow Line into Hamas-held territory. (Source: @manniefabian/59221)
IDF eliminates Muhammad Abu Alwan, head of Hamas finance department in Khan Yunis; leadership vows to prevent Hamas rebuilding. (Source: @almogboker78/18243)
Iran's Pezeshkian at UNGA asserts defensive systems ensure retaliation for any attack, rejects coercion, open to dialogue; US delegation walks out. (Source: @SharghDaily/185440)
Iraqi security forces defuse IED in Al-Rashad district, Kirkuk province; Kuwait discusses Iranian attacks and maritime security with Trump. (Source: @naya_foriraq/91392, @rodast_omiddana/81343)

points: President Pezeshkian's UN General Assembly speech emphasized Iran's defensive strength, willingness for dialogue, and rejection of coercion, stating Iran does not seek nuclear weapons but possesses the will to defend against any aggression; the US delegation walked out during his address. (Source: @SharghDaily/185440, @kianmeli1/92392)

The IRGC attacked the Indian-flagged bulk carrier Cape Dao in the Strait of Hormuz on September 23, killing one Indian crew member and injuring another; the vessel was evacuated and is burning, according to UKMTO and Iranian sources. (Source: @VahidOnline/78499, @kianmeli1/92394)
Mohsen Rezaei warned the United States has 4-5 days to comply with Iran's conditions, signaling a potential deadline for escalation. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/81352)
A senior Iranian official stated that reopening the Strait of Hormuz and lifting the US blockade were discussed during indirect talks with the US, per Reuters. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/7415)

New satellite imagery reveals damage to the Shahid Rudaki military site on Qeshm Island, belonging to the IRGC Ground Forces' Madineh Monawware Headquarters, which was targeted on July 30, 2026. (Source: @shin_persian/10368)

Iran's atomic energy organization spokesman asserted the IAEA has access to all facilities and no non-compliance has been reported despite multiple inspections; Pezeshkian separately declared Iran's defensive systems ensure any bombing of Iranian cities will not go unanswered. (Source: @naya_foriraq/91390, @presstv/207936)
Reports from Iran indicate explosions heard from the sea direction near Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz, suggesting possible further maritime activity. (Source: @New_security8200/203895)

The IDF activated Division 98 headquarters in Judea and Samaria, placing it in command of the Judea and Etzion brigades for the first time in over 20 years, per Chief of Staff Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir's directive to strengthen command and control amid recent events. (Source: @inon_yttach/10056, @yediotnews25/135283, @idf_telegram/25187)

Reserve soldier Neria Leiter, son of Israeli Ambassador to the US Yehiel Leiter, was seriously wounded in a ramming attack at the Maccabim checkpoint in the Benjamin Brigade sector; the terrorist was eliminated by forces on scene, and the soldier was evacuated to hospital. (Source: @New_security8200/203902, @almogboker78/18246, @manniefabian/59229)

The IDF eliminated Muhammad Abu Alwan, head of Hamas's finance department, in Khan Yunis; Prime Minister and Defense Minister stated Israel will not allow Hamas to rebuild its strength and will continue until Hamas is gone from Gaza. (Source: @almogboker78/18243)
Israeli combat engineers discovered a 600-meter-long tunnel in the central Gaza Strip crossing from the Israeli side of the "Yellow Line" into Hamas-held territory. (Source: @manniefabian/59221)

The sixth submarine, INS Drakon, arrived in Israel after construction delays due to a European embargo; the Navy revealed vessels operated for weeks off enemy shores in the Red Sea undetected, and a broad buildup plan includes more submarines, semi-autonomous and unmanned vessels. (Source: @yediotnews25/135274)

IDF forces arrested two suspects after detecting suspicious movement on the eastern border in the Jordan Valley sector, with Border Police and Judea/Samaria police participating in the pursuit. (Source: @idf_telegram/25175)

The Kiryat Shmona municipality announced the IDF will conduct a wave of strikes in Lebanon in the coming hours, warning residents of possible explosions; routine continues with no special instructions. (Source: @New_security8200/203905)

A ramming attack at the Maccabim checkpoint in the Benjamin Brigade sector seriously wounded a reserve soldier; the terrorist was eliminated by forces on scene, and the brigade commander ordered all fighters to return to their security mission immediately. (Source: @inon_yttach/10057, @New_security8200/203914, @almogboker78/18246)

Division 98 activation splits West Bank command between two division headquarters for the first time since the early 2000s, enhancing command and control over the Judea and Etzion brigades. (Source: @yediotnews25/135283, @idf_telegram/25187)
A 600-meter tunnel was located in the central Gaza Strip crossing from the Israeli side of the "Yellow Line" into Hamas-held territory, discovered by combat engineers. (Source: @manniefabian/59221)
The IDF eliminated Muhammad Abu Alwan, head of Hamas's finance department, in Khan Yunis, part of ongoing efforts to degrade Hamas's financial infrastructure. (Source: @almogboker78/18243)

Two suspects were arrested after suspicious movement was detected on the eastern border in the Jordan Valley sector by IDF observations, with Border Police and district police involved. (Source: @idf_telegram/25175)

The wounded soldier Neria Leiter is the son of Ambassador Yehiel Leiter; his brother Maj. (res.) Moshe Yedidya Leiter was killed fighting Hamas in northern Gaza in November 2023; a prayer gathering was organized at the Western Wall. (Source: @manniefabian/59229, @amitsegal/65131)

Hezbollah has reportedly transferred precision missiles, air defense systems, weapons, and ammunition to villages west of the Blue Line south of the Litani River, including Aqlim al-Tuffah, Jabal al-Rihan, and Jabal Safi, to establish fortified rear positions away from Israeli fire belts. (Source: @New_security8200/203900)

The IDF announced a wave of strikes in Lebanon in the coming hours; the Kiryat Shmona municipality warned residents of possible explosions but stated routine continues with no special instructions. (Source: @New_security8200/203905)
Warplanes were reported flying over the Western Beqaa area, with caution advised; artillery shelling was reported in the Hadatha area. (Source: @redlinkleb/44558, @redlinkleb/44594)
A heroic operation by Mahmoud Suleiman was reported near the Beit Ur checkpoint, described as a martyrdom operation. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/394293)
Iraqi security forces defused an improvised explosive device in the Al-Rashad district of Kirkuk province in northern Iraq. (Source: @naya_foriraq/91392)
The foreign ministers of Turkey, Saudi Arabia, and Syria met on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly in New York. (Source: @asafroz/53700)
US Secretary of State Marco Rubio accused the Houthis of attacking diplomatic facilities, calling them an "evil force in the region." (Source: @naya_foriraq/91381)
The Houthis announced the death of a senior commander named Saddam Ghalab. (Source: @asafroz/53693)
US Secretary of State affirmed commitment to fulfill obligations under the defense agreement with Saudi Arabia. (Source: @naya_foriraq/91378)
